constraints: One evidence-role warrant hypothesis, no case-specific rule or source identity.
Independently freeze synthetic semantic contrasts and rubric before inference; a new design is required for arbitrary fixture counts and three arms.
Use a fresh direct arm and unchanged Candidate3 comparator when assessing Candidate4, with fixed balanced ordering and full failure denominators.

Require an actual reduction of audited role/target errors without control regressions. If both candidates already pass all contrasts, a ceiling result does not establish benefit or justify another unchanged exposed-pair rerun.
Do not conflate exact citations with the adequacy of an observation or a claimed authentication.
Retain adequate single first-hand, constitutive, attribution and derivation controls; no missing evidence to false or universal corroboration requirement.
No broader accuracy claim from synthetic or reused real cases. Additional unused event families and independent confirmation are still required.
If there is no distinguishing historical evidence, prompt changes cannot establish unavailable later falsity.
